question: In which Indian city is the DY Patil Cricket Stadium located?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Navi Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **DY Patil Cricket Stadium** is located in **Navi Mumbai**, a planned city in the state of **Maharashtra, India**.
 
• It is officially known as the **Dr. DY Patil Sports Academy** and is renowned as a world-class sports facility.
 
• Established in **2008**, the stadium has a seating capacity of around **55,000**, making it one of the largest cricket stadiums in India.
 
• The stadium is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities and has hosted several **Indian Premier League (IPL)** matches and international cricket games.
 
• It was also used as a venue for football matches during the **FIFA U-17 World Cup** hosted by India in 2017.
 
• In addition to cricket, the stadium is designed for **multi-purpose sports**, including football and music concerts.
 
• The **architectural design** of DY Patil Stadium is unique, featuring cantilevered roofs that provide unobstructed views to spectators.
 
• It is named after **Dr. DY Patil**, a renowned Indian educator and philanthropist, whose contributions to education and sports are widely recognized.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pune**__

 __
 
• **Pune** is another major city in **Maharashtra**, known for its educational institutions and cultural heritage.
 
• While Pune has cricket stadiums, such as the **Maharashtra Cricket Association (MCA) Stadium**, it is not the location of the DY Patil Stadium.
 
• The MCA Stadium is located in **Gahunje**, near Pune, and has hosted international and IPL matches.
 
 
 
• **Aurangabad**__
 __
 
• **Aurangabad** is a historical city in Maharashtra, famous for its proximity to the **Ajanta and Ellora Caves**, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• It is not known for major cricket stadiums and does not host significant sports events like Navi Mumbai.
 
 
 
• **Nashik**__
 
 
• **Nashik**, also in Maharashtra, is famous for its **wine production** and religious significance as a site for the **Kumbh Mela**.
 
• Although Nashik has sports facilities, it is not home to the DY Patil Cricket Stadium.
